messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER: prod-usw2 GPU queue spiked 6.2x, autoscaler unable to attach new GPU nodes. Severity: P1. Paging on-call. Incident channel created: #incident-1758765432

pagerduty-bot: Paging maya (ops-oncall) — acknowledged. Estimated affected customers: multiple realtime inference tenants, elevated 5xx + tail latency.

maya: on it, joining bridge. quick status?

devon: seeing 40k token-s/sec backlog in gpu-inference queue, autoscaler logs show repeated "AttachRole not authorized" and ASG stuck at Desired=0->Attempting. Nodes are in EC2 but NotRegistered in the cluster.

rafael: concretely: kubelet logs on the new instances show: 
```
E0731 15:02:10.123 kubelet.go:123] failed to register node: failed to assume role: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole
```

priya: that looks like instance profile/iam role propagation problem after launchtemplate update we rolled earlier. Launch template no longer references the attach-role instance profile. Rolling back template might unblock but we need safe plan (some nodes are already up).

maya: can we temporarily scale a different pool (non-LT) with spare GPUs and divert traffic? We need to stop customer impact first.

devon: yes, we have a hotpool in prod-usw2-gpu-hot with different launch config (old profile). I can kick a manual scale of +6 from 2->8. That should absorb backlog for ~12-18min. Doing now: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name prod-usw2-gpu-hot --desired-capacity 8`

ops-runbook: Runbook step: if autoscaler fails to attach nodes due to IAM, fallback to manual ASG scale and mark affected nodegroups read-only in routing. Also notify customers via status page.

maya: devon please confirm nodes become Ready. I'll update status page and start mitigation notes.

devon: new instances launching, I see ec2 IDs: i-0b1..., i-0b2..., i-0b3... kubelet still failing for one of them with same AssumeRole error. Two nodes registered, three pending.

rafael: checking launchtemplate history: last LT v6 removed instanceProfileName accidentally during a multi-region promotion. We pushed v7 rolling back to include the profile but some nodegroups still use stale config. Suggest: 1) Revert LT in production to v5 (known-good) 2) Force new nodegroup rollout 3) Patch autoscaler policy to avoid flipflop.

priya: I can revert LT to v5. ETA ~6m to roll. Warning: scaling existing ASGs may pick v6 templates unless we explicitly update ASG to point to v5.

maya: agree. devon, keep hotpool scaled until backlog below threshold. devon: can you also untaint any nodes if taints causing scheduling backlog?

devon: checked pods — not tainted. Some nodes show taint gpu-provisioning:NoSchedule due to cluster-autoscaler marking them cordoned before kubelet registration. I'll force uncordon after node registers.

priya: started LT revert to v5 for the problematic nodegroup: `aws ec2 modify-launch-template --launch-template-id lt-0abcd --default-version 5`. Monitoring.

devon: two more nodes became Ready. backlog decreased ~70%. Good. One older node still stuck in NotReady with sts error.

rafael: we should confirm root cause: LT v6 missing instance profile + transient STS permission boundary on role. We will open a ticket with infra-iam to audit role boundaries. For now revert + manual scale is mitigation.

maya: status page updated: "We are mitigating a GPU capacity issue in us-west-2 causing elevated latency for some customers. Engineers are scaling spare capacity and rolling back a recent launch template change. No customer data exposure suspected. We'll post updates every 15 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-runbook: Next steps checklist: [x] manual scale hotpool, [x] revert LT, [ ] verify autoscaler reattaches, [ ] remove manual scale, [ ] follow-up RCA.

priya: LT revert finished. ASG for gpu-nodegroup still references v6 — updating ASG to point to v5 and triggering instance refresh. `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name prod-usw2-gpu-nodes --launch-template "LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcd,Version=5"`

devon: instance refresh started. new nodes come up and register cleanly. cluster-autoscaler logs show fewer errors now: "Instance joined, node registered". Backlog down to ~2k token-s/sec, within acceptable SLO.

maya: great. I'll stop the pager for now but keep channel open for follow-ups. Mark incident as mitigated, but keep P1 until autoscaler stability verified for one hour.

rafael: note for RCA: avoid removing instanceProfileName in LT updates without ASG patch; add CI check to ensure new launch templates include necessary IAM profiles.

maya: thanks all. I'll create incident ticket with timeline and action items (RCA owners: rafael/priya/devon). If anyone has customer-specific impact info DM me. :white_check_mark:
